name: Felwrath can be cast while moving; Ruin cannot (#1486)
contract: Issue #1486 asks whether Felwrath should be cancelled by movement. Live client Spell.dbc: Felwrath rank 1 520236 has a 1500 ms cast (CastingTimeIndex 16) and InterruptFlags 0x2 (SPELL_INTERRUPT_FLAG_PUSH_BACK only, no SPELL_INTERRUPT_FLAG_MOVEMENT 0x1), and its description names no movement restriction; every Felwrath rank (520688-520693) carries the same InterruptFlags 0x2. The same tree's Ruin rank 1 801895 has a 2500 ms cast (CastingTimeIndex 19) and InterruptFlags 0xF, which includes the movement bit. Spell::prepare refuses a player's cast-time spell while moving with SPELL_FAILED_MOVING (51) only when its InterruptFlags carry SPELL_INTERRUPT_FLAG_MOVEMENT, and Spell::update cancels a started cast on movement only under the same flag. Both spells cost 30 Energy and require the caster aura 803468 'At Least 2 Felfury' (CasterAuraSpell), so Energy, two Felfury (800058) stacks and 803468 are fixtured before each cast. Expected: while the Felsworn moves forward, Ruin is refused with reason 51 and deals nothing, and Felwrath starts, is not refused, keeps casting and deals damage to the target.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Felsworn knows Felwrath rank 1
SETUP: the Felsworn knows Ruin rank 1
Ruin costs 30 Energy
Two Felfury stacks
Ruin requires 'At Least 2 Felfury' (CasterAuraSpell 803468)
Start moving forward
SETUP: the Felsworn is moving
CONTROL: Ruin while moving
CONTROL: Ruin (InterruptFlags 0xF, movement bit set) is refused with SPELL_FAILED_MOVING
Let any Ruin cast that was allowed complete
CONTROL: the refused Ruin deals nothing
Felwrath costs 30 Energy
Two Felfury stacks
Felwrath requires 'At Least 2 Felfury' (CasterAuraSpell 803468)
SETUP: the Felsworn is still moving
Felwrath while moving
CONTRACT: the moving Felsworn is casting Felwrath
CONTRACT: Felwrath (InterruptFlags 0x2, no movement bit) is not refused
SETUP: the Felsworn kept moving during the cast
CONTRACT: the Felwrath cast completes while moving and damages the target
Stop moving
